description: Prospective runtime-bound authorization for governed v5 training. Extends v1 with device/runtime binding; does not mutate v1 artifacts.

expected_resolved_device.description: Device the runtime must resolve to. Must equal resolved requested_device. For GPU authorization both are 'cuda'.

expected_runtime_identity_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical runtime-identity-v1 payload that the observed runtime must match. Freeze value before training.

expected_runtime_identity_schema.description: Runtime identity schema version the expected hash was computed under. Present for provenance; not independently enforced beyond hash match.

semantics.historical_v1: Byte-identical, CPU-only. No device/runtime fields. Runner treats missing device as cpu and refuses CUDA.
semantics.prospective_v2_gpu: requested_device=cuda, expected_resolved_device=cuda, expected_runtime_identity_sha256=17e3bb52d5893c4e09ecb759a925004f2e75a37d7d4faf4ece7de41f81870ada (CUDA 13.2, torch 2.13.0+cu132, driver 610.47, RTX 4070 Laptop GPU CC 8.9, determinism enabled)
fail_closed: v1 authorization must not contain v2 device/runtime fields
semantics.no_silent_fallback: CUDA requested but unavailable raises RuntimeError; never falls back to CPU.
semantics.capture_point: After resolve_device and configure_device_determinism, before execution_started, before any scientific computation. Single normative point.
semantics.driver_note: nvidia_driver_version is part of runtime-identity-v1. A driver update intentionally changes the identity and requires a newly bound future authorization.
semantics.identity_drift_note: Prior commit a781206 recorded cuda identity 35d07adc53bebe974457f2e87e8af0b4ff9d3f0cb19791f6370f8cf98d82ffbd captured before deterministic flags were applied. Normative capture after configure_device_determinism yields 17e3bb52d5893c4e09ecb759a925004f2e75a37d7d4faf4ece7de41f81870ada; new value is authoritative prospectively.

usage: Do NOT create a seed-05 GPU authorization in this task. Create only schema/parser/test fixtures. Future GPU executions must be authorized with a new v2 JSON containing the three fields above.
